ITEM 1 | Dark purple-brown roasted pieces with charred edges and glossy, slightly oily sheen, cut into thick wedge/strip shapes about 4-5 cm long and 1.5-2 cm thick, some with caramelized browning and a pale cut interior face, clustered on the left side of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Bright green cooked spears, smooth-skinned and firm, about 15-18 cm long and roughly 1 cm thick, with trimmed woody ends, lying in a bundle across the center of the plate with slight sheen | 60
ITEM 3 | Fresh loose dark green leafy greens with lobed, peppery-looking leaves and thin pale stems, lightly dressed with a faint shine, spread across the lower-left and right half of the plate in a loose mound about 15 cm across | 70
ITEM 4 | Small wilted reddish-purple leaf pieces, limp and slightly glossy, tucked beneath the green spears near the center | 8
ITEM 5 | Thin dark glossy brown liquid sheen or dressing film visible on the greens and roasted pieces, pooled lightly on the plate surface | 5
